title: Composition of abelian higher direct image transitions
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], I a preorder, and D : Iᵒᵖ → Over S any functor. Let F_i be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], with inverse-image coefficient maps φ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the displayed identity and composition coherence. For every p ≥ 0 and composable f : i → j, g : j → k, the canonical abelian higher direct image map [def-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-map] for f followed by g equals the composite of the maps for f and g. No affine, qcqs, directedness, or limiting-cone hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tag 09Z1 canonical comparison maps; derived adjunction functoriality

proof.text: Expand both transitions before homology as units followed by the inverse-image comparisons, counits and coefficients. Naturality moves the intermediate derived unit past the first coefficient map. The adjunction triangle identity cancels the intermediate counit and unit.

Associativity coherence of inverse-image composition and its single-functor comparison identifies the remaining factors with the single composite transition. Substitute hφcomp and D.map_comp in the opposite order. Apply homology, which preserves composition. Structure-map equality transports agree by proof irrelevance.

theorem abelianHigherDirectImage_transition_comp {S : Scheme.{v}}
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Over S)
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (((D.map f.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hφid : ∀ i : I, HEq (φ (𝟙 i))
      ((upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.obj (op i)).left).hom.app (F i)))
    (hφcomp : ∀ {i j k : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k), HEq (φ (f ≫ g))
      ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.map g.op).left
          (D.map f.op).left).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((D.map g.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ φ g))
    (p : ℕ) {i j k : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k) :
    abelianHigherDirectImageMap (D.map (f ≫ g).op).left (D.obj (op i)).hom
        (D.obj (op k)).hom (Over.w (D.map (f ≫ g).op)) p (F i) (F k) (φ (f ≫ g)) =
      abelianHigherDirectImageMap (D.map f.op).left (D.obj (op i)).hom
          (D.obj (op j)).hom (Over.w (D.map f.op)) p (F i) (F j) (φ f) ≫
        abelianHigherDirectImageMap (D.map g.op).left (D.obj (op j)).hom
          (D.obj (op k)).hom (Over.w (D.map g.op)) p (F j) (F k) (φ g)
